title: heavenly egyptian rice tagine
description: a rich and aromatic rice tagine dish from egypt, featuring buttery and pillowy texture, perfect for a date night. it's a vegetarian-friendly and flavorful recipe.
instructions: heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the pumpkin seeds and cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
add the long-grain rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
add the date syrup, allspice berries, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, and kosher salt. stir to combine.
add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
serve the rice hot, garnished with additional pumpkin seeds and allspice berries if desired.
